rootCause.explanation: ParameterValueWidget.getRequiredActionIcon explicitly renders a clear action for a required parameter with no default, and calls setValue(null). rootCause.explanation: Inline title onHeaderChange calls the generic onSave handler without rerunQuery:false. useSaveQuestion forwards an unspecified rerun flag into apiUpdateQuestion, which defaults structured questions to rerunQuery=isResultDirty and dispatches runQuestionQuery after saving.
